description: Give the date of the next review for one topic, so you get a single date instead of the whole schedule. It is the first review that is not on or after the exam and has not passed yet, counting from the day you first studied it. The answer counts the reviews that already passed. Use make_spaced_repetition_schedule when you want every review date. Dates can be plain text, like Dec 12 or in 3 weeks. Example prompt: "When should I review the routing I studied on 2026-11-01 for my exam on 2026-11-30?"

exam_date.description: Exam date, if any. Reviews on or after it are skipped. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

first_study_date.description: The day you first studied it. Defaults to today. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

from_date.description: The day to count from. Defaults to today. Reviews before it have passed. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

intervals_days.description: Days after the first study to review.

name: next_review_dates
title: Next review date
